topics.title: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and NLP

concepts.learning_objective: Describe AI as simulating human cognitive functions using a knowledge base.
Explain how machine learning models are trained and tested on data to make predictions.
Identify applications of NLP such as predictive typing, speech-to-text and machine translation.
Distinguish virtual reality from augmented reality and give their applications.
Describe robots, their types and applications such as rovers, humanoids and drones.
Explain what big data is and why traditional tools cannot process it.
Identify the five Vs of big data: volume, velocity, variety, veracity and value.
Describe data analytics and its uses in business and science.

topics.title: Internet of Things, Web of Things, Sensors and Smart Cities

concepts.learning_objective: Define IoT as a network of devices with embedded hardware and software that exchange data.
Explain how WoT uses web services to connect IoT devices through one interface.
Describe the role of sensors, including smart sensors, in IoT and smart cities.
Explain cloud computing as on-demand, pay-per-use services delivered over the Internet.
Distinguish IaaS, PaaS and SaaS with examples.
Describe a grid as dispersed, heterogeneous nodes working together on a large task.
Identify data and CPU grids, middleware like Globus, and contrast grids with IaaS.
Explain blockchain as a decentralised, shared, append-only ledger kept by all nodes.
Evaluate applications of blockchain in currency, healthcare, land records and voting.
